value.rationale: Single-gain instability observations cannot rule out controller-gain retuning or choosing a different residual norm. The new algebraically located common arc proves that these two natural design adjustments, and any ordinary limiter with positive operating-point derivative, all fail together for the specified I-feedback family. This is a meaningful structural step-size-control design obstruction, not a routine computational parameter substitution.
